messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use escitalopram you also take pimozide or citalopram (Celexa).
Do not use escitalopram within 14 days before you have used an MAO inhibitor.
Do not use escitalopram within 14 days after you have used an MAO inhibitor.
Examples of MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue injection, phenelzine, rasagiline, selegiline, and tranylcypromine.
Some young people have thoughts about suicide when first taking an antidepressant.
Stay alert to changes in your mood or symptoms.
Report any new or worsening symptoms to your doctor.
Seek medical attention right away if you have symptoms of serotonin syndrome.
Symptoms of serotonin syndrome include agitation, hallucinations, fever, sweating, shivering, fast heart rate, muscle stiffness, twitching, loss of coordination, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
Do not stop using escitalopram without first asking your doctor.

B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
D. 'is not considered addictive in the way': The subject drug is not considered addictive in the same manner or to the same extent as the substance or class of substances specified by the object entity.
